questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a primitive type in Java?
explanations: int is a 32-bit integer primitive type.
boolean is a primitive type that only accepts true or false.
String is a class (reference type), not a primitive type.
char is a primitive type that stores a Unicode character.

explanations: const does not exist as a functional reserved word in Java.
